summary: P5 Stripe billing (iteration_6) fully verified. Backend: 51/51 pytest tests PASS in 17.94s (39 prior + 12 new billing/free-tier). Frontend: 9/9 UI flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Billing endpoints correctly exclude Mongo _id via projection {_id:0}.
Free-tier gate returns detail as dict {code, message, limit} — machine-readable shape matches frontend RepoPicker handler.
Webhook signature verification is enforced: bad + missing 'stripe-signature' both return 400 'Invalid signature'.
billing_checkout is idempotent per user: reuses customer_id via _get_or_create_customer with upsert keyed by user_id (no duplicate billing rows on repeat call — verified).
GET /api/payments/status/{sid} is intentionally unauthenticated to support post-checkout polling — verified 200 without auth, 404 for unknown sid.
PaymentSuccess polling has MAX_POLLS=12 * 2s = 24s — reasonable. Without session_id it correctly transitions to error state (still shows polling card briefly, which is acceptable per playbook).
test_credentials: Ephemeral direct-Mongo seeded users + user_sessions + billing + payment_transactions (per /app/auth_testing.md). Fully wiped after run.
seed_data_creation: Tests seed: free user, pro user (billing.subscription_status='active'), paid payment_transactions row (payment_status='paid'), github_connections with Fernet-encrypted fake token, 3 projects for free-tier gate. Cleanup runs in fixture teardown + explicit mongo delete at end of playwright script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend billing tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py under '# Billing / Stripe (iteration_6)' section (lines 601+). Uses real Stripe test-mode API (STRIPE_MODE='test', lookup_key='pro_monthly'). checkout returns real cs_test_ session IDs, portal returns real billing.stripe.com URL. Do NOT complete real checkout in tests.
